issue.title: sase memory init writes the chezmoi home root to the live ~/.local/share/chezmoi, bypassing the workspace-private /sase_repo clone
issue.description:
`sase memory init` resolves its home-root target from `use_chezmoi: true` plus `repos.linked.chezmoi.path`, so it writes to and auto-commits in the live host checkout at ~/.local/share/chezmoi. It never consults the workspace-private clone that `sase repo open chezmoi` prepares for an ephemeral `sase_<N>` workspace.

That breaks the isolation contract every other repo write in SASE honors. An agent that correctly opens chezmoi through `/sase_repo` gets one path for reads and a different, live, shared path for `sase memory init` writes — so half its changes land in the isolated clone and half in the user's real dotfiles checkout, and the two silently diverge.

task_type_fields.impact: Any agent regenerating home memory from an ephemeral workspace commits directly to the user personal dotfiles repo without a /sase_final repository obligation, and its /sase_repo clone stays stale. Concretely, sase-vk.3 also hand-edited chezmoi/sase/memory/README.md in the live checkout to keep it consistent with where init had written, then had to leave that edit uncommitted because a phase worker must not commit to the user dotfiles unprompted; the sase-vk land agent then had to redo the same edit in the /sase_repo clone. Recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 4 on sase-vk.3.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/main/init_memory/ home-root target resolution (use_chezmoi: true + repos.linked.chezmoi.path)
task_type_fields.repro: From an ephemeral sase_<N> workspace, run `sase repo open chezmoi -r "..."` and note the printed workspace-private clone path under sase/repos/linked/chezmoi. Then run `sase memory init`. The regenerated home/AGENTS.md, home/CLAUDE.md, home/GEMINI.md, home/QWEN.md, home/OPENCODE.md and home/sase/memory/ land in the live ~/.local/share/chezmoi checkout and are auto-committed there ("chore: initialize sase memory"), not in the printed clone. Observed 2026-08-30 by phase agent sase-vk.3, which produced chezmoi commit f429de9b in the live host checkout this way.
